data.name: Yuvank
data.long_meaning: Yuvank is a name of Sanskrit origin, derived from the words 'yuva' (youth) and 'ank' (energy or power). In Hindu mythology, Yuvank represents the energy and power of youth, and is often associated with the divine god Krishna, who embodies the eternal youth and joy of life.
